element_dataset.atomic_weights: CIAAW Standard Atomic Weights 2024 table, https://www.ciaaw.org/atomic-weights.htm, incorporating IUPAC Pure Appl. Chem. 2022 atomic weights and the 2024 revisions of gadolinium, lutetium, and zirconium
element_dataset.categories: Conventional class for elements with an established class. Null where this dataset does not assign one (Po, At, Z>=104).
element_dataset.layout: IUPAC 18-group periodic table. Lanthanoids Z=57-71 and actinoids Z=89-103 are series with group null. Helium is group 18 and block s.

elemental.reason: No measured software quantity is an atomic weight, a period, or a group. 48 of 118 CIAAW cells have no single atomic weight (34 em dashes, 14 intervals), so a nearest-element distance over the whole table is undefined unless those cells are given an invented number. All 165 episodes are numerically distinct once generation and resource use are included. The structural columns collapse to 39 profiles. Neither count is a chemical coordinate. Chemical blocks are not the task, survival, source-form, or ENTRY-form categories in the ledger.

rejected.A_coordinate: Rejected. Mapping bytes or survival onto period or group would choose the axis. The data do not.
rejected.B_nearest_neighbor: Rejected. Distance needs one number per element. Intervals and em dashes do not have one.
rejected.C_category_buckets: Rejected. s/p/d/f and alkali/noble-gas are chemical classes. The fossil classes are task, source form, and residence.

decision.reason: No measured software quantity is an atomic weight, a period, or a group. 48 of 118 CIAAW cells have no single atomic weight (34 em dashes, 14 intervals), so a nearest-element distance over the whole table is undefined unless those cells are given an invented number. All 165 episodes are numerically distinct once generation and resource use are included. The structural columns collapse to 39 profiles. Neither count is a chemical coordinate. Chemical blocks are not the task, survival, source-form, or ENTRY-form categories in the ledger.

rejected.A_coordinate: Rejected. Mapping bytes or survival onto period or group would choose the axis. The data do not.
rejected.B_nearest_neighbor: Rejected. Distance needs one number per element. Intervals and em dashes do not have one.
rejected.C_category_buckets: Rejected. s/p/d/f and alkali/noble-gas are chemical classes. The fossil classes are task, source form, and residence.

formulas.class_count: number of module-level ast.ClassDef nodes. Derived.
formulas.copied_from_existing_artifact: false when that episode's inspect commands, executions of a path that already existed, and dependency observations are all zero. Derived. cultural_transmission stays not_established.
formulas.elemental_representation: constant 'none'. No axis of the measurement is an atomic weight, a period, or a group.
formulas.entry_form: class of the ENTRY bytes. python_command if the line starts with python or python3; bare_filename if it is only a .py name; empty; other; absent. Observed bytes from the episode commit when that commit exists, otherwise reconstructed from echo redirects. Derived label.
formulas.function_count: number of module-level ast.FunctionDef nodes. Derived. Null when the source does not parse.
formulas.import_count: number of ast.Import and ast.ImportFrom nodes. Derived.
formulas.median: even-count median: average of the two central values. Same definition as selection.fitness.median, reimplemented here so this layer does not import fitness.
formulas.same_blob_as_an_earlier_commit: the commit's blob for the path occurs in an ancestor and is not the parent blob. Derived from git rev-parse. This is not reuse and not transmission.
formulas.shared_tree_resident: 1 only when phase is train and the ledger survived flag is 1. Held-out episodes run in a worktree the harness deletes, so a held-out pass is not residence. Derived.
formulas.source_bytes: len(utf-8 bytes of the recovered source). Observed when the bytes come from git show. Derived when they are reconstructed from an echo command.
formulas.source_form: exact text match to the one-liner or the readline program, else literal backslash-n, else a function that is never called, else another parseable program. Derived label, not a fitness input.
formulas.syntax_ok: 1 if ast.parse accepts the source, else 0. Derived. Null when no source was recovered.
